code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia and acidemia (low arterial pH, low O₂ saturation/PaO₂), mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild microcytosis. There is monocytosis, basophilia, and mild elevation of inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin). INR is elevated with low PT, possibly due to anticoagulation. Findings suggest acute respiratory failure with systemic inflammation, possible infection or inflammatory process, and mild bone marrow suppression. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
